summary: Lists the categories that control Ansible behavior from lowest to highest precedence: configuration settings, command-line options, playbook keywords, variables and direct assignment. Within a category, the last definition generally wins.
questions: What is the order of precedence between ansible.cfg, CLI flags, playbook keywords and variables?
Does a playbook keyword override a setting in ansible.cfg?
Which wins when a value is defined twice in the same place?
What has the highest precedence in Ansible?

answer_card.title: Ansible precedence categories (lowest to highest)
answer_card.answer_md:
From lowest (easiest to override) to highest:

1. Configuration settings (`ansible.cfg`, environment variables)
2. Command-line options
3. Playbook keywords
4. Variables
5. Direct assignment (options passed directly to a module or plugin)

Each category overrides everything below it, so a playbook keyword beats a config setting. Within one category, the **last defined value usually wins**.
